title: On Expanding the school to three rooms
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：expand　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expand 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the director ① expanded the school to three rooms year after year, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② expands the school to three rooms for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ expand the school to three rooms at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ expanded the school to three rooms before — a line in the poster for August 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Expanding the school to three rooms year after year, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ expand to twice its width in water for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Expand to twice its width in water at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ expands to twice its width in water year after year every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ expanded the school to three rooms again when nobody else would.

⑩ To expand the school to three rooms, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody expands the school to three rooms for the whole place again and somebody must expand the school to three rooms year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 扩大（一般过去式 expanded the school to three rooms：1958 年导演头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 扩大（一般现在 expands the school to three rooms：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 扩大（不定式 to expand the school to three rooms：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 扩大（过去完成时 had expanded the school to three rooms：1952 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 扩大（动名词 expanding the school to three rooms 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 膨胀（expand to twice its width in water：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去膨胀在水里涨到两倍宽）
G. v. 膨胀（expand to twice its width in water：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 扩大（后段两处：新来的演员照例 expands to twice its width in water，而母亲又一次 expanded the school to three rooms）

answers.why: expand 意为“扩大”，1958 年导演年年地扩大把学堂扩成三间，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 expanded。
expand 意为“扩大”，自那以后导演替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 expands。
expand 意为“扩大”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯扩大把学堂扩成三间”，此处为不定式 to expand the school to three rooms。
expand 意为“扩大”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人扩大过，故用过去完成时 had expanded。
expand 意为“扩大”，导演说“扩大把学堂扩成三间这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 expanding the school to three rooms 作主语。
expand 意为“膨胀”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去膨胀在水里涨到两倍宽”，should ever 之后用原形 expand to twice its width in water。
expand 意为“膨胀”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻膨胀在水里涨到两倍宽（expand to twice its width in water at once），以后再也不要提起。
expand 意为“扩大”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例膨胀在水里涨到两倍宽，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 expands。
expand 意为“扩大”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地扩大把学堂扩成三间，用一般过去式 expanded 叙述。
expand 意为“扩大”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要扩大把学堂扩成三间，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 expand 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the director expanded the school to three rooms year after year, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director expands the school to three rooms for the whole place whenever the theatre asks.
Expanding the school to three rooms year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever expand to twice its width in water for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre expands to twice its width in water year after year every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother expanded the school to three rooms again, and the theatre remembered that half.
